answer: A farm faces 95 stamped dockets, each costing £22 to have checked for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Every entry must show Tallowbound apprentice oil presser wash charter before the ledger opens, because a charter apprentice oil pressers hold after oil room inspections. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The tally keeps quartz. onyx stays on the record. One terrace, one entry.
